One quick thing before you paste: I'd keep the ticket **factual** ("did not remit by deadline") rather than asserting motive ("intentional"). Most host portals treat any unpaid share past cutoff as a forfeit anyway, so the deposit offset works the same — and you don't end up with a formal record claiming you know what's going on with his mom based on a Discord status. Streaming is not proof either way, and if it turns out he's telling the truth, "intentional" in writing is the thing that blows up the friendship, not the $200. If the other guests insist on the word, I've given you an optional line you can toggle.

*(Optional, only if the group requires it: "The remaining guests have agreed to treat this as a voluntary forfeiture of his spot.")*

Please confirm receipt and whether any additional forms are needed. I'll be available in the portal until the deadline.

Thank you,
[Your name] — Group organizer, Booking [#]
